# PyRel application corpus

Five exact shipped models, one positive/negative pair per rule and positive,
missing and extra controls for each complete BookRec derived head.
`matrix.json` enumerates inputs and narrated control stories. Expected business
answers live separately in `answers.json`; its full GND observations are measured
comparison data, while target outcomes were chosen from the stories before runs.
No native acceptance is implied by GND observations.
